kind.description: Always decision_needed. This schema is only for escalating a choice the Worker must not make alone.

question.description: The single decision the Lead has to make, stated as one question.

evidence.description: What was found that forces the decision: file paths, symbols, exact output lines. One item per observation.

options.description: The distinct options considered, one per item, each with its trade-off.

recommendation.description: Which option the Worker recommends, and why in one or two sentences.
